entry.name: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Generative AI LLMs
entry.note: The entry credential in the NVIDIA program for generative AI and large language models
entry.audience: Developers and practitioners working with large language models

reading.format: The exam lasts 1 hour and has 50 to 60 multiple choice questions. It is offered in English. Candidates need a Certiverse account to access the exam.
reading.summary: The NVIDIA Certified Associate Generative AI LLMs credential is an entry level certification. It confirms a candidate has the foundational concepts needed to develop, integrate and maintain applications that use generative AI and large language models with NVIDIA solutions. Candidates who pass receive a digital badge and an optional certificate naming the level and topic.
reading.audience: The page describes it as an entry level credential. It is aimed at people who already have a basic understanding of generative AI and large language models.
reading.validity: The certification is valid for two years from issuance. Recertification may be achieved by retaking the exam.
reading.prerequisites: A basic understanding of generative AI and large language models.
